contract: Read six frames of normalized interleaved float32 PCM, including the final silent frame, and put the same PCM in contiguous planes before the measured operation.
Create a fresh encoder and send the full six-frame input 49 times through one stream. Emit one complete 1536-sample AC-3 syncframe per input frame, then drain and close.

Cover both complete 44.1 kHz frame-size cycles in the 294-frame session. Match the actual encoded byte and packet counts and the per-packet fold of the rate, bitstream ID, layout and nominal bitrate fields.
Use the same pinned FFmpeg 9.0.2 release profile as the audio decode comparisons, with planar float input and one thread through its public frame and packet API.
The packet fold compares the encoded work for timing and memory collection. Output streams for signal comparisons come from ac3-encode-emit and are decoded with strict CRC checking.
